_: THE vocabulary, once. Python (funnel.py), the work rail (funnelPile.js) and the Timeline (timelineState.js) all build their tables from this file, so a word cannot mean one thing on the rail, another in chat and a third on the Timeline. Three groups by PURPOSE, not three vocabularies: `lanes` is what is happening to a piece of live work (it also carries the funnel's ordering, so nothing may be added here that is not live work); `kinds` overrides a lane where the lane is not enough; `states` is what the Timeline says about a row that is no longer live work. A word lives in exactly one of them. `counted` is the plural-counting form for prose and defaults to `word`. A lane's RULES live beside its words (taskuary/lanes.py and website/src/lanes.js read them): `section` is the rail section a row of this lane falls in when nothing outranks it, `on_you` whether it is the owner's move at all (only `theirs` among the work lanes is not), `waits` whether it is blocked on the owner's answer or yes, `urgent` whether every row of the lane is urgent, `urgent_request` whether an ask triage called urgent is urgent. An urgent row (`urgent` below) has no section of its own: it sits in its lane's section at its arrival place, shaded, and Next walks it in its place like any other row. `sections` is the rail's headings in order, `item_kinds` what each kind of row is called when counted and whether it is mail or an agent's, `idea_kinds` the Advisor's own kinds of line.

lanes.hint: an agent is waiting on you — it asked, needs your approval or is stuck, and it is blocking work
lanes._says: the ONE sentence each sub-state of this lane gets, on every surface (workerstate.says / funnelPile.says). `line` when the request has words, `bare` when it does not. asking = a question, approval = a permission, stalled = a turn that died on a wall (rate limit, token ceiling) with the CLI alive at its prompt, parked = quiet at its prompt with nothing recorded

lanes.hint: a meeting today or inside two hours (it turns urgent fifteen minutes before), or an urgent sender
a reply, an action or a task's close-out (approve its change, close it where it lives) waits for your yes
a person asked you for something and nobody is on it
real work with nobody on it yet
your task, waiting on somebody else - it comes back when they answer
meant for an agent, and nothing is running it — the row says why: held for you, waiting its turn, or a start that failed
an agent worked this and left without finishing - its work so far is kept
you ended the agent's session - its report is written and the task is still open
a report or workflow you set up could not run - the cause is in it

lanes._section: fyi while the automatic retry still may judge it; a row the retry gave up on (`held`) is On you - lanes.band_of
lanes.hint: Taskuary couldn't sort this — nothing was started; open it and press Sort it again, or choose what it is
quiet past that person's usual day - chase, let it go, or say where they answered
a report you set up landed, or an agent finished a job
a person told you something — read it or don't

lanes._section: a task an agent is working is a task like any other, under Tasks where the walk's order puts it, its icon ringed while the agent works (the owner, 2026-10-21) - it never moves between sections as the agent starts, asks, finishes or stops
lanes.hint: an agent is working on it — its icon spins until it finishes, asks, fails or is stopped
lanes._says: the one sentence for an agent that has been started and has said nothing yet (laneSays.starting): `line` names the AI it runs on, `bare` when that is not known

kinds.hint: the agent finished and its result is ready to read
the reply went out and the agent is finished, but the task is still open
you sent it and it was refused - the reply is kept, and the row says why
a reply is drafted, and this channel cannot send it from here - copy it and answer there
a goal with a date: its steps are tasks, and it stays on the rail until it is done
a goal past its date, or a step somebody owes past theirs
a goal nothing has moved on yet

states.hint: the task is closed - by you, or by the agent that finished it
the message has arrived — triage is deciding where it belongs
first message from this address — nothing was started on it by itself
a note you left yourself — nothing is working it, and nothing will
the sender deleted this where it came from — kept here, with whatever was done about it
you replied to this yourself, outside Taskuary — nothing here is waiting on you
the last word is yours — a reply went out and nothing has come back. The ball is in their court, not yours
the task was dropped - nobody works it any more, and search still finds it

_sections: THE RAIL'S SECTIONS, in the rail's order: the heading (`word`; a sentence says it in lower case), the attention band whose rows it holds (null for a section placed by more than its band: For later by Remind me or a goal scheduled to come back, Advisor ideas by an fyi-band idea), what its heading's tip says (`{button:<id>}` is that button's name), `on_you` - what the opener's headline, the greeting and the header count as on you - and `to_read` - the reading that sits apart. There is no Urgent section (the owner, 2026-10-22): see `urgent`.

sections.hint: every open task, whether an agent is working on it or not - a spinning ring is an agent at work, a goal with news is here and its steps are rows of their own. Next moves on for this walk; the task stays here, and the next walk starts with it again
still yours - put away with Remind me, or a goal waiting for its next news; each comes back when its time says
a report you set up landed - information, never a task
people told you things - read them or don't

_urgent: URGENT IS A SHADE, NOT A SECTION (the owner, 2026-10-22: "remove the urgent section and just add quiet shading around it"): a row in attention band `band` is drawn in `section` at its arrival place, never moved, and shaded; Next reaches it in its place like any other row and never jumps to it (the owner, 2026-10-22: "you go through it like all other tasks"). `minutes` is how close a meeting comes before it turns urgent (funnel.ALERT_MIN).

urgent.hint: a meeting inside fifteen minutes, an ask triage called urgent, or a sender on your escalate list

_item_kinds: EVERY KIND OF ROW: how a sentence counts it (`one`, `many`; a kind not here is 'other thing'), `mail` - it came in as a message (the opener's mail tally, and the chat says who wrote it) - and `agent` - it is an agent's own news, so its row names the agent when it has one.
_idea_kinds: THE ADVISOR'S KINDS OF LINE (assistant.py): `word` is what its card and its Timeline row call it, `counted` how a report's last run counts its candidates, `section` where the brief puts a line the model did not place (assistant.SECTIONS). A kind not here is an 'advisor idea' in Worth a thought.
